name: Berlin Wall
hook: A city divided, a wall built and torn down, and the century's most famous crossing.

facts.statement: The Berlin Wall was built in 1961; East German leader Walter Ulbricht ordered its construction.

facts.label: Checkpoint Charlie
facts.statement: Checkpoint Charlie on Friedrichstrasse was the famous crossing between East and West Berlin.

facts.label: John F. Kennedy
facts.statement: John F. Kennedy visited the Wall in 1963 and said democracy never had to build a wall to keep people in.

facts.label: Peter Fechter
facts.statement: Peter Fechter was shot trying to climb the Wall in 1962 and died after his pleas for aid went unanswered.

facts.label: November 9, 1989
facts.statement: The Wall fell on November 9, 1989, as the Cold War ended and the Soviet bloc broke apart.

facts.label: 28 years
facts.statement: The Wall stood 28 years, from 1961 to 1989; its fall spelled the end of East Germany.

facts.label: The Wall concerts
facts.statement: Roger Waters performed The Wall at the site in 1990, and David Hasselhoff sang on the Wall to a million people.
